purpose: Finite release-source and public declaration observations, not runtime or ABI qualification. Proprietary artifacts remain private.

release.acquisition: The official release page linked this HTTPS download. The ZIP, embedded installer package and selected members were read without executing the downloaded installer.
release.signature_boundary: Embedded code-signing certificates were observed, but Authenticode image integrity, timestamp and certificate-chain trust were not verified. HTTPS acquisition and byte equality are the asserted source binding.

comparison: Each of the six selected installed/reference files was byte-identical to the corresponding member extracted from the downloaded package. This is not a complete installed-file manifest.

copied_application_tree.manifest_encoding: UTF-8 JSON of records sorted by path; object keys sorted, separators comma/colon, no extra whitespace. Each record carries path, bytes, sha256, container and matching_cab_members.
copied_application_tree.comparison: Every file in the copied application tree matched installer-member bytes, including the added MapForce.inst resource. The comparison inspected hashes and names, not implementation bodies.
copied_application_tree.scope: This binds that copied application tree, not the complete product installation, registry, license state, Wine or operating-system libraries, external catalogs, or generated output. It does not establish signature trust or execution semantics.

type_library.name: MapForceLib
type_library.scope: Read-only declaration metadata, not COM activation or Windows ABI evidence. The separate online COM catalog retains its own unestablished release binding.

generated_source.input: Tutorial/ConvertProducts.mfd and its three matched schema/instance dependencies
generated_source.generator: The matched executable, in an isolated offline Wine environment
generated_source.settings: The loaded tutorial's inherited settings; File / Generate Code in selected C# and Java separately. No application-wide default is inferred.
generated_source.input_guards: All four input files remained byte-identical; the declared mapping output was not created.
generated_source.csharp_project_target: .NET Framework v4.8.1 in all four generated project files
generated_source.scope: Candidate public declaration facts from these two source bundles only. No generated program was compiled or run. Lifetime, ownership, null/error behavior and undocumented overloads are not inferred.

installed_declarations.scope: Declaration only. This resolves the pointer-versus-value source discrepancy, not lifetime, ownership or null/error behavior.
Declaration spelling only. The different literal spelling in the manual remains preserved; no throw-site, compatibility-alias or runtime claim follows.

Declaration discrepancy only. The type library declares a VARIANT pointer with both input and output flags, while the online catalog describes an output Boolean. Initial-value requirements, accepted variant types, coercion, mutation, errors and ownership remain unqualified; no alias or compatible runtime behavior is inferred.
